name: Crocodile Cult Priest

alignment.name: Evil
alignment.description:
Evil creatures don’t necessarily go out of their way to hurt people, but they’re perfectly willing to take advantage of the weakness of others to acquire what they want.
	Evil creatures use rules and order to maximize personal gain. They don’t care whether laws hurt other people. They support institutional structures that give them power, even if that power comes at the expense of others’ freedom. Slavery and rigid caste structures are not only acceptable but desirable to evil creatures, as long as they are in a position to benefit from them.

items.name: Whip
items.description: Stories of novices injuring themselves with this weapon underscore the difficulty of mastering the whip, but in the hands of an expert, a whip can drag a foe down, drive away a vicious animal, or even wrap around a loose object at a distance.

description: This is the size of a typical human and serves as a standard in the game. This category has no special rules.

powers.name: Whip
powers.requirements: The priest must be in human or hybrid form.

hit.description: damage, and the priest can pull the target 1 square or make the target fall prone.

powers.name: Bite
powers.requirements: The priest must be in crocodile or hybrid form.

hit.description: damage, and the target is grabbed (escape DC 20). The target takes ongoing 10 damage until the grab ends.

effect.description: The priest can alter its physical form to appear as a crocodile, a human–crocodile hybrid, or a unique Medium humanoid until the priest uses change shape again or dies.

powers.name: Call for Vengeance
powers.trigger: An ally within 5 squares of the priest is killed by an enemy attack.

effect.description: Any ally within 5 squares of the priest gains a +5 bonus to weapon damage rolls until the end of the priest’s next turn.
